WITH la_fontaine_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'La Fontaine' AND addr_state ILIKE 'Indiana'
)
SELECT MIN(rast_val) AS lowest_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, (ST_DumpAsPolygons(ST_Clip(rast, 1, la_fontaine_geom.geom, TRUE))).geom) AS rast_val
  FROM public.dem_us
  CROSS JOIN la_fontaine_geom
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, la_fontaine_geom.geom)
) sub;
